title: Umut Candan — Shipped Work
tagline: Small web apps that do one thing, live in the browser, and need no account.
_categories: Topic -> display category. This is the primary mechanism: add these topics to a repo on GitHub and it files itself. Repos matching nothing land in 'Other' and are listed loudly in the build output. Order matters — the first category with a matching topic wins.

categoryBlurbs.Mind & Focus: Tools for attention, calm, and the habits that hold a day together.
categoryBlurbs.Games: Short, playable, nothing to install. Several work with friends over a room code.
categoryBlurbs.Worlds & Simulations: Systems you can poke at to see how the rules play out — from a single lattice cell to the whole planet.
categoryBlurbs.Learning: Things you use repeatedly to get measurably better at something.
categoryBlurbs.Essays & Investigations: Arguments laid out with the evidence attached, and the data left where you can check it.
categoryBlurbs.Faith: Practical companions for daily religious practice, and books worth reading slowly.
categoryBlurbs.Tools & Platforms: The larger builds — control planes, directories, and infrastructure for other people's software.
categoryBlurbs.Other: Live projects that haven't been given topics yet.
